_origin.raw_title: OpenAI prompt-to-voice creates reusable voices for GPT-Live agents

walkthrough.use_case: Give a customer-onboarding voice agent a consistent, clearly disclosed adult speaking style.
walkthrough.steps:
Write a precise adult voice description covering age range, tone, pace, accent and delivery style.
Create it with POST /v1/audio/voices using type prompt, a name, the description and model auto; add a representative script_hint when useful.
Save the returned voice ID, set it in session.audio.output.voice.id, and repeat the original description in the GPT-Live session instructions.
Evaluate a fixed script plus several conversation turns for clarity, consistency and brand fit before deployment.
walkthrough.availability: Generally available to API customers. OpenAI allows up to 100 prompt-generated voices per organization; creating one is free, while generated speech is billed at GPT-Live rates.
walkthrough.limitations: Prompt-generated voices work only with GPT-Live, not TTS, Realtime or Chat Completions. Voice creation is not compatible with Zero Data Retention. Voices are not guaranteed unique. Use adult voices, do not impersonate people, and disclose AI-generated speech.
walkthrough.evidence_label: OpenAI's October 16 documentation reviewed; AI Daily Diff did not create, hear or test a voice or run GPT-Live.

youtube_description:
OpenAI prompt-to-voice became generally available to API customers on October 16. This builder briefing shows how to create a reusable synthetic voice for a GPT-Live agent, attach its voice ID and evaluate it before deployment.

- Describe an adult voice with its tone, pace, accent and delivery style, then create it through POST /v1/audio/voices with type prompt.
- Save the returned voice ID in session.audio.output.voice.id and repeat the original description in the GPT-Live session instructions.
- Evaluate a fixed script and several conversational turns for clarity, consistency and fit. AI Daily Diff reviewed the documentation; we did not create, hear or test a voice live.
- Prompt-generated voices work only with GPT-Live. Organizations may create up to 100; voice creation is not compatible with Zero Data Retention, voices are not guaranteed unique, and generated speech must be disclosed as AI.

Follow AI Daily Diff for verified voice-agent capabilities, practical builder workflows and clear implementation limits.
